response.overview: This is the first artistic response by Ebba Jahn to COVID-19 social distancing requirements in Berlin. In this new situation video artistic expression could find a different way via 15 seconds of found animation footage which is freely available with a creative commons licence. Now prolongated it may give viewers a minute of aw and encouragement while moving through their present disturbances – at least the filmmaker finds her lockdown vibes colorfully reflected.
response.title: #Stay Home...
